gaps.sentence: A new proposal was put ___ at the meeting.
gaps.explanation: put forward = propose, suggest (an idea, plan, name).

gaps.sentence: Please could you look ___ my plants while I'm away?
Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).

gaps.sentence: Hold ___ a moment — I'll check if he's in.
gaps.explanation: hold on = wait (especially on the phone).

gaps.sentence: We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
I stand ___ my decision — it was the right one.
gaps.explanation: stand by something = continue to support it; stand by somebody = help and support them.

gaps.sentence: The car ___ down on the motorway and had to be towed.
The plane takes ___ in ten minutes.
gaps.explanation: take off = leave the ground (plane); also remove clothes; become successful (career took off).
